_note: The teaser line under the facts row (owner, 2026-11-11: 'Please try your best remembering the goal'). One true sentence about the visitor's OWN address, read from the registry the site already ships, sized against a year everybody knows. It is the hook that makes somebody on their way to the store stop for a second. Content is data: add an anchor by adding a row; js/27-teaser.js names none of them.
_evidence: The year is the registry's record for the block containing the visitor's address (the date that allocation or assignment was registered) - a registry fact, known without asking anyone. The anchors are well-documented public dates; each 'event' must be true for the whole calendar year it is attached to, and must read correctly after 'the year', 'two years before' and 'a year after'. Never add an anchor you cannot source. No fear appeal: this is about the address's history, never about the visitor.
_pick: Nearest anchor within maxGap years. An exact year wins; otherwise the nearest anchor AFTER the block's year ('N years before X' - it makes the address feel old, which is the pleasure); otherwise the nearest before.

line.same: Your address comes from a block registered in {year}, the year {event}.
line.before: Your address comes from a block registered in {year}, {gap} before {event}.
line.after: Your address comes from a block registered in {year}, {gap} after {event}.
